## What's New in v1.6.6 — Larger Nav Bar Icons & Collapsed Category Vaults

### 🚀 UI Refinement & Navigation Ergonomics
- **Larger Navigation Bar Icons:** Increased floating navigation bar icon size from `20dp` to `25dp` for high legibility & touch accuracy.
- **Collapsed Sub-Folders by Default:** All feature category cards (`ExpandableCategoryCard`) are now neatly collapsed by default across Privacy, General, and Style screens, expanding smoothly only when tapped.
